item.title: Letter: Meaningful immigration reform is overdue
item.description: With all of the incoming vitriol leveled against the Trump administration, it might be prudent to remind the people of Minnesota that Gov. Tim Walz has presided over one of the largest taxpayer fraud schemes in modern history.

item.title: Ask a Trooper: Alternatives to help with traction on slippery roads
item.description: Question: Hi, I read your “Ask A Trooper” article regarding winter travel survival kit essentials. You might reconsider recommending cat litter as an agent for traction.

item.title: My Point of View: Vote for good governance and not only emotions
item.description: Americans vote for representatives who govern our society. We must educate ourselves and not vote based on soundbites or emotional validation. Our society has failed to practice responsible governance, and it is up to us to implore God’s grace and strive to practice responsible citizenship.

item.title: Guest column: Red tape is strangling rural health care. Let’s make the choice to cut it.
item.description: Rural America is running out of doctors. According to a recent report from the Commonwealth Fund, 43 million Americans now live in rural communities facing a shortage of primary care providers.

item.title: Editorial: Progress is a story of you; look for it later this month
item.description: As we speak, we are putting the finishing touches on what is by far our biggest endeavor of the year: our annual Progress edition.

item.title: 'Something you can get lost in': Albert Lea artist joins Art Center to display abstract paintings
item.description: The Albert Lea Art Center has once again brought in a talented local artist to display their work in the gallery this month. Right now, that artist is Troy Doyle.

item.title: Arletta Marie (Olson) Woods
item.description: Arletta Marie (Olson) Woods, age 93, of Glenville, Minnesota, lived a long and beautiful life and passed away peacefully on January 27, 2026, surrounded by family at Rochester Health Services in Rochester, Minnesota.
